# Details for our guests

- Ceremony: Saturday 12 June, 2:30pm, St Brigid's Church, Aldwick. Please be in your seats by 2:15pm.
- Lunch and dancing: The Old Mill, Aldwick, from 4pm until late.
- Parking: free at the Old Mill only. The church has no car park, so please walk or share a lift.
- Dress: smart. The church can be cold, so bring a wrap.
- Gifts: no gifts please, a card is lovely. There is a donation box for the lifeboat charity at the Mill.
- Children: welcome at both. There is a quiet room with games at the Mill.
- Reply: by 15 May to Joss on 07700 900123.
- Rooms: a block of rooms is held at the Aldwick Arms until 1 May. Quote "Penn wedding".
